Re: Dispute of Account ACC-273982

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute letter regarding your account with us, ACC-273982. We understand that you have reported an incident of identity theft connected to a data breach, which has resulted in fraudulent activity on your credit profile.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and the New York State General Business Law, we are required to investigate your dispute. We will review the account information and verify the accuracy of the charges. As per your request, we will also provide you with a validation of the debt, which includes the original creditor, Greenfield Energy, and the current balance of $5,198.33.

We will conduct a thorough investigation of the account and will remove or block any information that is found to be inaccurate or unauthorized. We will also review the inquiries listed in your dispute letter to determine if they were made by you or not.

Please note that our investigation may take some time to complete, and we will notify you of our findings as soon as possible. You have the right to dispute any information that you believe is inaccurate or incomplete.

If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us. We appreciate your cooperation in this matter.
